column1: # When each path that the ops repo's git does not track last changed, as a
# UTC time on the course clock (2026-10-19T09:00:00Z). seed.sh shifts every
# time by (the seed's clock - the course clock): exact under faketime, and the
# same ages in a learner's own workspace. A path ending in / stamps the folder
# and everything in it. Tracked files take the time of the last commit that
# changed them (seed/ops-history.tsv), and folders the time of their newest entry.
